is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 1, 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions that the vector population is resistant to pyrethroids mediated by kdr and P450 enzymes (page 2), but it does not report any genotype data for these markers in the current study.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies are provided for any resistance markers.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Ganhoua village, Benin (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical entomological trial.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was performed from April to May 2022 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new entomological trial.

supplement.evidence: No genotype data is reported in the paper or supplementary materials.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the entomological efficacy of a transfluthrin passive emanator (Mosquito Shield) against pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. in Benin. While it reports bioassay results for insecticide resistance, it does not report any molecular marker genotype data.
